text: openai-codex-image 是面向 DSH Web 的 ChatGPT 生图插件：在 DSH 注册图片生成与账号授权工具，并提供设置页查看登录状态和默认参数。用户可提交中文或英文画面描述，选择尺寸、质量和模型，把 PNG 保存到工作区，也可在当前对话支持图片时内联查看。适合想用 ChatGPT 账号在 DSH 中生成插图并管理授权的用户；需要可使用 Codex 的 ChatGPT 账号，不需单独配置 API Key。

openai-codex-image adds image-generation and account tools plus a DSH settings page. Submit a prompt, choose size or quality, and save a PNG in the workspace; supported models can show it inline. Sign in with a ChatGPT account that can use Codex; no separate API key is needed.
想在 DSH 里根据文字描述生成一张图片
帮我把生成的图片存到当前会话的工作目录
I want to sign in with my ChatGPT account and make images from prompts in DSH
openai-codex-image 的功能「提示词生成图片」：调用 generate_image 并传入画面描述，可选尺寸、质量和模型；生成的 PNG 保存到工作区目录，并在支持图片输入的对话中附带图片结果。
openai-codex-image 的功能「账号授权管理」：通过 openai_account 或设置页查看状态、开始设备码登录、确认登录和退出插件保存的授权；设置页同时展示账号状态与生图默认参数。
openai-codex-image 使用前须知：生图时会把提示词发送到 chatgpt.com；设备码授权及令牌交换会连接 auth.openai.com。使用前需准备可使用 Codex 的 ChatGPT 账号。

openai-codex-image README · dsh-openai-codex-image：A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin that signs in with a **ChatGPT account** (Codex OAuth) and generates images through the ChatGPT **subscription quota** instead of a paid API key.

[](https://github.com/kkczx5428/dsh-openai-codex-image/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[English](README.md) | [中文](README.zh.md)

openai-codex-image README · Why：OpenAI's `gpt-image-2` is documented for the paid API-key path (`api.openai.com`). If you already pay for ChatGPT, an agent that calls the image API pays for the same model twice. This plugin follows the same route the Codex CLI uses:

```
POST https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/responses
  tools: [{ type: "image_generation", model: "gpt-image-2", size }]
  tool_choice: { type: "image_generation" }
```

openai-codex-image README · Why：…authenticated with the ChatGPT OAuth access token + `chatgpt_account_id`. Image calls ride the ChatGPT subscription instead of API credits.

> This is an unofficial integration of a Codex CLI endpoint. It is not affiliated with OpenAI, and OpenAI may change the endpoint at any time. Make sure using it complies with the terms that apply to your account.

openai-codex-image README · Demo：Both images were generated with `generate_image` through a ChatGPT subscription account:

| `1024x1024` request (actual 1312x1199) | `1536x1024` + `quality=low` (actual 1672x941) |
|---|---|
|  |  |

openai-codex-image README · Features：- `generate_image` tool: prompt → PNG file in your workspace, displayed inline in chat when the active model accepts image input.
- `openai_account` tool: status / device-code login / poll / logout.
- **Settings → ChatGPT Image** page: authorization status (source, account, plan, token expiry), the device-code login flow, sign-out, and the current image defaults — the same-origin routes never return tokens.
- Auth resolution: plugin-owned OAuth record in DSH credentials first, then the local Codex CLI login (`~/.codex/auth.json`, **read-only**).
- Automatic token refresh for the plugin-owned record (refreshed tokens are written back to the same DSH credential record).
- No hard dependency on `@deepseek-ai/*` packages: the plugin only uses Node built-ins and the services on the DSH context, so it works as a locally installed bundle.
- Original SVG icon, localized metadata (en / zh).

openai-codex-image README · Requirements：- DSH Desktop (or a DSH profile with the `credentials`, `attachments`, `workingDirectory` and `llm` services).
- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.
- A ChatGPT account that can use Codex, logged in either through:
  - the Codex CLI (`codex login`), or
  - this plugin's device-code flow.

openai-codex-image README · Install：```bash
git clone https://github.com/kkczx5428/dsh-openai-codex-image.git
```

In a DSH session, ask the agent to run:

```
plugin_manager(action="install_bundle", target="<absolute path to the cloned directory>")
```

`install_bundle` links the directory into the active profile and appends the bundle to the profile. Restart DSH after changing plugin source; installing a new bundle applies immediately.

To remove it:

```
plugin_manager(action="remove_bundle", target="openai-codex-image")
```

openai-codex-image README · Usage：```
generate_image(prompt="A red panda with round glasses using a glowing laptop, cozy study, 3/4 view")
generate_image(prompt="...", size="1536x1024", quality="low", output_dir="assets")
```

openai-codex-image README · Usage：| Parameter | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `prompt` | yes | Image description; Chinese and English both work |
| `size` | no | `1024x1024` (default), `1536x1024`, `1024x1536`, `2048x2048`, `2048x1152`, `3840x2160`, `2160x3840` |
| `quality` | no | `auto` / `low` / `medium` / `high` |
| `model` | no | Image model, default `gpt-image-2` |
| `host_model` | no | Conversation model that hosts the `image_generation` tool; default from config |
| `output_dir` | no | Relative to the session workspace, or an absolute path; default `generated_images` |
| `file_name` | no | Optional file name (`.png` is appended, path parts are stripped) |

openai-codex-image README · Usage：Returns `path`, actual `width`/`height`, `bytes`, `model`, requested `size`, optional `revised_prompt`, and an `image` attachment block when the active model accepts image input.

The backend snaps requested sizes to the aspect ratios it supports; the returned dimensions are the real ones.

openai-codex-image README · Account authorization：| Action | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `status` | Show auth source, account, plan, token expiry, image defaults |
| `login_start` | Start OpenAI device-code login; returns `https://auth.openai.com/codex/device` plus an 8-character code |
| `login_poll` | Call after finishing browser login to exchange and store the token |
| `logout` | Delete the plugin-owned credential (the Codex CLI login is left untouched) |

Device-code flow:

openai-codex-image README · Settings page：DSH → Settings → **ChatGPT Image** shows the current authorization source, account, plan and token expiry, starts the device-code login, confirms it, and signs the plugin-owned credential out. It reads the plugin's own same-origin routes under `/api/openai-codex-image/*`; the page receives no tokens (the account id is masked).

openai-codex-image README · Settings page：The page is the browser half of the bundle (`client.js`). Client bundles load when the host starts, so **restart DSH Desktop after installing or upgrading this plugin** to see a new or changed settings page.

openai-codex-image README · Authentication sources：1. **Plugin credential** — DSH credential record `openai-image/chatgpt` (`kind: "grant"`, payload `{ type: "oauth", access, refresh, expires, accountId, ... }`). Refreshed automatically 60 seconds before expiry; refreshed tokens replace the same record.
2. **Codex CLI** — `~/.codex/auth.json` (`auth_mode: "chatgpt"`). Read-only: the plugin never writes to it, so token rotation in the Codex CLI stays consistent. If it is expired, the plugin asks you to run `codex login` or use the device-code flow.

openai-codex-image README · Configuration：All keys are optional and live in the bundle's `cordis.patch.yml` row config:

| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `authFile` | `~/.codex/auth.json` | Codex CLI login file |
| `hostModel` | `gpt-6.1-sol` | Conversation model hosting `image_generation` |
| `imageModel` | `gpt-image-2` | Image model |
| `defaultSize` | `1024x1024` | Default size |
| `outputDir` | `generated_images` | Default output directory |
| `timeoutMs` | `240000` | Per-request timeout, 30s–600s accepted |

openai-codex-image README · Troubleshooting：| Symptom | Meaning / fix |
|---|---|
| `HTTP 400 ... model is not supported when using Codex with a ChatGPT account` | The host model is unavailable for your account. Pass another `host_model` (values can be found in Codex's `models_cache.json`, e.g. `gpt-6.1-sol`, `gpt-6-sol`, `gpt-5.6-sol`). |
| `HTTP 401/403` | Authorization invalid or expired; run `openai_account(action="login_start")`. |
| `HTTP 429` | Rate or quota limit; wait for the subscription quota to reset. |
| Timeout | Raise `timeoutMs`; typical generations take 20–60 s, larger sizes longer. |
| Image not shown inline | The active model does not accept image input; the PNG is still saved at `path`. |
| Settings page missing after install/upgrade | Client bundles load at host start; restart DSH Desktop. |

openai-codex-image README · Development：```bash
node --check index.js   # syntax
node scripts/smoke.mjs  # registration/schema smoke test, no network
```

`dsh.client` + `./client` export are what make the Settings page load. **`exports` must include `"./package.json": "./package.json"`**: DSH's client-module scan locates a bundle's manifest through `require.resolve("<package>/package.json")`, and without that subpath export the scan silently skips the package — the host half and tools work, but the settings page never appears.

openai-codex-image README · Development：Layout:

```
index.js            # all plugin logic (Host half, Node built-ins only)
client.js           # Settings page (browser half, hand-written ModuleLoader bundle)
cordis.patch.yml    # inserts the openai-codex-image row
package.json        # dsh.bundle.patch -> cordis.patch.yml; dsh.client -> client.js

openai-codex-image README · Development：Verified end-to-end on Windows (2026-10-26): real image generation through a ChatGPT subscription account, inline image results, sized and quality-controlled output, the error paths above, and the full device-code login (`login_start` → browser login → `login_poll` → credential stored in DSH → generation using that stored credential). CI covers the offline smoke test only; network and account flows need a real account.

openai-codex-image README · Security：- Tokens live only in the DSH credential store and in the Codex CLI's own `~/.codex/auth.json`; the plugin never logs or copies them.
- `logout` removes only the plugin-owned record; run `codex logout` separately to sign the Codex CLI out.
- Prompts are sent to OpenAI — that is inherent to image generation.
- See [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) for reporting vulnerabilities.
